business_problem: C-Metric needed to help a healthcare-services client search fragmented document repositories, reduce data errors and make compliance-heavy workflows faster and more reliable.
solution_summary: C-Metric applied its Aivio virtual assistant to a healthcare-services environment using a layered IBM AI stack. IBM watsonx Assistant provides the conversational interface, while IBM watsonx.ai and IBM Granite foundation models generate context-aware responses. IBM Watson Discovery adds retrieval-augmented understanding over the client’s document repositories, and the overall solution integrates through secured APIs with role-based access so data privacy requirements such as HIPAA, GDPR and SOC2 can be respected. Aivio also includes an Excel analyzer for large datasets, turning document and spreadsheet content into action items for business teams. In the implemented workflow, users query the assistant in natural language, supporting content is retrieved from multiple systems, and the platform returns answers, summaries and operational insights. This lets the healthcare provider turn scattered, compliance-heavy information into a coordinated search and decision-support experience.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Provides the conversational interface for Aivio so users can retrieve information through natural-language interactions.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Generates detailed, context-aware responses for the assistant.

solution_components.name: IBM Granite
solution_components.role: Supplies the foundation models used to create contextual responses in Aivio.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Applies retrieval-augmented understanding across the healthcare provider’s document repositories.

solution_components.name: Aivio
solution_components.role: Packages the IBM AI components into an enterprise virtual assistant and analytics experience for the client.

data_flow: Documents and spreadsheet data from disparate repositories are accessed through secured APIs, retrieved and interpreted by Watson Discovery and watsonx.ai, and then returned to users through Aivio’s assistant interface as answers, summaries and action items.
business_outcome: The healthcare client achieved faster information retrieval, far fewer data errors and lower operational costs, while C-Metric proved the value of its IBM-powered assistant in a regulated environment.
architecture_clues: Can run on IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure or on premises
Includes an analyzer for Microsoft Excel
Designed for regulated healthcare data environments
evidence_quotes: Built with the IBM® watsonx Assistant® virtual assistant, Aivio offers advanced natural language processing (NLP) capabilities.
The solution also includes the IBM Watson® Discovery document understanding platform, which applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to improve comprehension and relevance.

The company achieved a significant ROI, including a 40% reduction in operational costs, 85% faster data access, USD 150 thousand annual cost savings and over USD 250 thousand in additional annual revenue.
